setup_notes: Fork main fast-forwarded to upstream (00825634) and pushed. `run --stats` no longer exists on main; stage timings taken with debug build `--trace` + sumtrace.py.

hypotheses.title: Final-reassignment CFG analysis allocates and copies a map per basic block per fixpoint pass (O(blocks x tracked finals))
hypotheses.issue: The final-reassignment data-flow analysis (stage 8) represents per-block state as possiblyAssignedState = map[model.SymbolRef]bool. entryState allocates a fresh map for every block on every pass (>=2 fixpoint passes plus a reporting pass) and maps.Copy's each predecessor's exit map into it, growing/rehashing as it goes; analyze then compares states with maps.Equal per block per pass. assign/transfer also build the diagnostic description string for every assignment on every pass, even for untracked targets or non-reporting passes. Cost is O(#blocks x #tracked finals) allocation and work per pass. It triggers on any function with deferred-init final locals, module-level deferred finals, or a class init whose class has final fields without defaults. The sibling uninit-var/uninit-field analyses were just moved to dense bitsets (common/bitset, init_state.go); this one was not. On the reproducer, maps.Copy in entryState accounts for ~72% of all bytes allocated (449 MB of 619 MB) and the CFG Analysis stage takes ~850 ms vs a few ms without `final`.

reproducer.generator:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a function with F deferred-initialized locals and N if/else branches.

usage: gen.py F N out.bal [final|plain]
  final: locals declared `final int fK;` (triggers final-reassignment analysis)
  plain: locals declared `int fK;` (control; final-reassignment analysis skipped)
"""
import sys
F, N, out = int(sys.argv[1]), int(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3]
mode = sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) > 4 else "final"
q = "final " if mode == "final" else ""
L = ["import ballerina/io;", "", "public function main() {"]
for k in range(F):
    L.append(f"    {q}int f{k};")
for k in range(F):
    L.append(f"    f{k} = {k};")
L.append("    int acc = 0;")
for i in range(N):
    L.append(f"    int v{i} = acc + {i};")
    L.append(f"    if v{i} > {3*i} {{ acc = acc + v{i}; }} else {{ acc = acc - 1; }}")
L.append("    int s = 0;")
for k in range(F):
    L.append(f"    s = s + f{k};")
L.append("    io:println(acc + s);")
L.append("}")
open(out, "w").write("\n".join(L) + "\n")
reproducer.command: python3 gen.py 200 4000 final.bal final && go build -o /tmp/bal ./cli/cmd && hyperfine -N -w 1 -r 8 '/tmp/bal run final.bal'  (control: gen.py 200 4000 plain.bal plain; stage timings: go build -tags debug -o /tmp/bal-debug ./cli/cmd && /tmp/bal-debug run --trace=f.json final.bal)

hypotheses.baseline: main 00825634: final.bal (F=200 final locals, N=4000 if/else) 1.278 s ± 0.046 s wall, ~385-400 MB max RSS, CFG Analysis stage ~850-980 ms; control plain.bal (same without final) 0.37-0.38 s, ~200 MB. Class-init variant (200 final fields, branchy init): 1.21-1.25 s, CFG Analysis ~950 ms vs 0.37-0.41 s control. Cost scales linearly in F and in N (F=50/100/200 -> 252/444/846 ms; N=2000/4000/8000 -> 447/846/1750 ms).

improvement.summary: CFG Analysis stage ~850-980 ms -> ~12 ms (-98.7%); end-to-end wall 1.278 s -> 0.399 s (3.2x, hyperfine); benchmark tool time -64%, peak memory -47.6% (382 MiB -> 201 MiB) on the reproducer; class-init variant CFG Analysis 892 ms -> 14 ms. Reproducer now runs as fast as the no-final control.

hypotheses.fix_approach: Intern the tracked final refs into a bitset.Context[model.SymbolRef] once per analyzer and represent each block's exit state as a bitset.BitSet (F=200 -> 4 words). analyze reuses a single scratch state across all blocks/passes: entryState clears it and ORs in each parent's exit (no per-block allocation); change detection is a word-wise Equal followed by CopyFrom into exits[i]. Lookup failure doubles as the 'is tracked' check. assign takes kind+name and builds the 'cannot assign a value to potentially initialized final ...' message only when an error is actually reported. Needed two small additions to common/bitset: BitSet.Clear(pos) (for re-definitions) and BitSet.Equal. Pitfalls: keep the back-edge merge, topological order and the reachability skips unchanged so diagnostics and their order stay identical; message text must match existing corpus goldens (final-*-e.txtar). make test passes unchanged.

notes: Confirmed on first hypothesis and first fix attempt; stopped per routine rules. Memory-mode summary flags the improvement as borderline unreliable (worst CV 3.0%) but the 47% drop is ~15 sigma and corroborated by /usr/bin/time RSS (~390 MB -> ~205 MB).
